tenantContextFindingsSummary: Every selected reference (CAND-01/02/03) and every anti-pattern instance applies an explicit non-optional clinicId predicate at the DB layer. No currently-merged production path passes a raw unvalidated req.user.clinicId/JWT-default into a security-critical where clause. The one confirmed unscoped-tenant-context signature is PR #304's unmerged implementation (CAND-07), not present on main.
dtoRawPrismaFindingsSummary: No candidate examined defines a named, shared TypeScript DTO type on main. CAND-01/02/03 use narrow Prisma-inferred select projections (no leakage). CAND-05's dashboard.ts agenda/activities sections use include-based passthroughs of full Appointment/ActivityLog scalars (leakage). dentalChart.ts (§4/crossDomainAntiPatternInstances) returns a raw Prisma model with no select narrowing.

rejectedPatterns.note: not found as a security-critical instance in currently-merged production code; documented and rejected in principle by F2-PREP-009 §3; two non-scoping locale/timezone req.user!.clinicId reads found and recorded as non-violations

designInputSources: CAND-07 document only, not PR #304 source (named DTO practice, typed-error design)

testRequirements: Every future implementation of the proposed template must include a real DB-backed test invoking the actual exported function/route (per paymentsListFieldScope.test.ts's standard), not a mirrored/simulated reimplementation.

Cross-tenant rejection tests must exercise the real function with a genuine cross-clinic/cross-org fixture, asserting an undifferentiated not-found/denied result — no candidate examined in this inventory currently meets this bar against its own real code path.
unresolvedDecisions: Whether findTreatmentCaseInClinic (CAND-02) should be relocated from utils/relationGuards.ts into a Treatment-Case-owned module, and whether its 7 call sites migrate in one pass or incrementally.

Whether resolvePatient (CAND-03) should be exported with a stable named type, and whether patientAnonymization.ts/orphanFileInspection.ts/deletionReviewInventory.ts should be required to re-call it instead of trusting a passed-in clinicId.

Whether the Billing financial-select selector (CAND-01) should be consolidated with the structurally identical narrow-selects in payments.ts/practitionerEarnings.ts into one shared, named, tested function.
Whether program ownership accepts F2-PREP-009's Option A design as the canonical tenant-context element for the proposed template, independent of PR #304's own resolution.
Whether a fourth 'barrel/facade convention' reference category should be added once any public.ts implementation actually merges to main (none exists today, CAND-06).
